meta.name: firebase-app-hosting-basics
meta.description: Deploys and manages full-stack web applications (Next.js, Angular) with Server-Side Rendering (SSR) using Firebase App Hosting. Use when deploying Next.js/Angular apps, configuring apphosting.yaml or firebase.json apphosting blocks, managing secrets, setting up GitHub CI/CD, or configuring Blaze billing requirements. Don't use for classic static web hosting, Auth, Firestore, Crashlytics, or Xcode.

howto.what: Claude 帮你部署和管理 Next.js、Angular 等全栈网站应用（含服务端渲染），并处理 apphosting.yaml、firebase.json 的 apphosting 配置、密钥设置等。
howto.when: 当你要部署 Next.js/Angular 应用、配置 apphosting.yaml 或管理密钥时接管；不用于经典静态托管、Auth 等场景。

say.text: 帮我把这个 Next.js 应用部署到 Firebase App Hosting

say.text: 在 apphosting.yaml 里配置环境变量和密钥
